integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the published recurrence relations and conjugacy; numerical checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local rare-invader criterion, not a theorem of eventual establishment, coexistence, competitive exclusion, or global basin structure.
Strict advantage requires a compact positive resident invariant state with positive mean resident-predator load.
The proof uses the \(\sigma=0\) Beverton–Holt + Nicholson–Bailey specialization and its exact native-system conjugacy.
title: Dynamical equivalence gives an exact oscillatory invasion advantage for juvenile predators
